search_document: Service Agreement › 7 Delivery and acceptance

7.1 The Supplier delivers the Goods to the Customer's warehouse at 14 Harbour Road within five working days of each purchase order, between 07:00 and 16:00 on working days, unless the order names a later date. Each delivery carries a delivery note that lists the order number, the articles, the quantities and the number of pallets.

7.2 The Customer inspects each delivery within two working days and reports any shortfall, damage or wrong article in writing, quoting the delivery note. Goods not reported within that time are accepted, except for defects that an inspection could not have found, which the Customer reports within ten working days of finding them.

7.3 For each working day a delivery is late, the Supplier credits the Customer 0.5 % of the value of the late Goods, up to 10 % of that value. The credit appears on the next invoice as a separate line. A delivery is not late when the Customer refused it, changed the order after it was confirmed, or when the delay arises from an event outside the Supplier's reasonable control that the Supplier announced in writing within one working day.

7.4 Invoices are issued per delivery and are payable within thirty days of the invoice date. Prices are those of the price list in force on the date of the order; a change to the price list applies to orders placed thirty days or more after the Supplier sent it. The Customer may withhold payment of any amount it disputes in good faith, provided it states the reason within fourteen days of receiving the invoice and pays the rest.

7.5 Either party may end this agreement with ninety days' written notice to the other. Orders confirmed before the notice ends are delivered and invoiced on these terms. The Customer may end the agreement at once if three deliveries in any period of six months are late by more than five working days each.
